result.instructions: Cryptographic tools that keep key material inside this server: generate or import a key to get a handle, then pass the handle to encrypt, decrypt, sign, KEM and KMS tools. No tool returns a private or secret key.

Cryptographic tools that keep key material inside this server: generate or import a key to get a handle, then pass the handle to encrypt, decrypt, sign, KEM and KMS tools. No tool returns a private or secret key.

tools.name: crypto_generate_key
tools.description: Generate a key inside the server: a classical (RSA, ECC, Ed25519) or post-quantum (ML-KEM 512/768/1024 FIPS 203, ML-DSA 44/65/87 FIPS 204) keypair, a 256-bit symmetric key, or an HMAC-SHA256 key. Returns a keyHandle and, for keypairs, the public key. Secret key material stays inside the server; only an opaque keyHandle is returned.

modulusLength.description: Modulus length for RSA (2048, 3072, 4096). Default is 2048.

curve.description: Elliptic curve for 'ecc': 'prime256v1' (P-256), 'secp384r1' (P-384), or 'secp256k1'. Default is 'prime256v1'.

tools.title: Generate a key

tools.name: crypto_key_list
tools.description: List the key handles this server holds, with each key's type and public metadata. At most 64 keys are held; beyond that the least recently used key is destroyed.
tools.title: List key handles

tools.name: crypto_key_destroy
tools.description: Destroy a key: overwrite its secret bytes where the runtime allows and invalidate its handle.

keyHandle.description: Handle of the key to destroy. Key handles look like 'kh_' followed by 32 hex characters.

tools.title: Destroy a key

tools.name: crypto_key_import
tools.description: Import an existing key from a file in the directory the server operator set in CRYPTO_MCP_KEY_DIR (disabled when it is unset). Reads an unencrypted PKCS#8 PEM private key (Ed25519, RSA 2048/3072/4096, ECDSA P-256/P-384/secp256k1; the type comes from the key) or a raw 32-byte key, as 32 binary bytes or 64 hex digits, imported as 'symmetric-256' (default) or 'hmac-sha256'. Files over 65536 bytes are refused. The key bytes never pass through the conversation. Secret key material stays inside the server; only an opaque keyHandle is returned.

path.description: Path of the key file, relative to CRYPTO_MCP_KEY_DIR. Absolute paths, '..' segments and symlinks that lead outside the directory are refused.

kind.description: For a raw 32-byte key only: 'symmetric-256' (crypto_encrypt, crypto_decrypt, crypto_kms_wrap; default) or 'hmac-sha256' (crypto_sign, crypto_verify).

tools.title: Import a key from a file

annotations.title: Import a key from a file

tools.name: crypto_inspect_key
tools.description: Inspect and parse PEM certificate, public key, or OpenPGP armored block.
tools.title: Inspect a public key

tools.name: crypto_encrypt
tools.description: Encrypt plaintext with authenticated encryption (AES-256-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305) under a symmetric-256 key handle. Without keyHandle, a new key is generated and its handle returned. Secret key material stays inside the server; only an opaque keyHandle is returned.

keyHandle.description: Handle of a symmetric-256 key. If omitted, a new key is generated. Key handles look like 'kh_' followed by 32 hex characters.

tools.title: Encrypt data

tools.name: crypto_decrypt
tools.description: Decrypt and authenticate an AES-256-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305 ciphertext with a symmetric-256 key handle.

algorithm.description: Algorithm used for encryption ('aes-256-gcm' or 'chacha20-poly1305'). Default is 'aes-256-gcm'.

keyHandle.description: Handle of the symmetric-256 key. Key handles look like 'kh_' followed by 32 hex characters.

tools.title: Decrypt data

tools.name: crypto_kem_encapsulate
tools.description: Encapsulate a shared secret to an ML-KEM (FIPS 203) public key (512, 768, 1024). Returns the KEM ciphertext for the recipient and a symmetric-256 keyHandle for the shared secret, usable with crypto_encrypt. Secret key material stays inside the server; only an opaque keyHandle is returned.

publicKey.description: Hex-encoded ML-KEM public key (1600, 2368, or 3136 hex characters).

level.description: ML-KEM security level (512, 768, or 1024). Default is 768.

tools.title: Encapsulate a shared secret

tools.name: crypto_kem_decapsulate
tools.description: Recover an ML-KEM shared secret with an ml-kem key handle (512, 768, 1024). Returns a symmetric-256 keyHandle for the shared secret. Secret key material stays inside the server; only an opaque keyHandle is returned.

keyHandle.description: Handle of the ml-kem key. Key handles look like 'kh_' followed by 32 hex characters.

ciphertext.description: Hex-encoded ML-KEM ciphertext (1536, 2176, or 3136 hex characters).

level.description: ML-KEM security level (512, 768, or 1024). Default is inferred from key or 768.

tools.title: Decapsulate a shared secret

tools.name: crypto_hybrid_kem_encapsulate
tools.description: Encapsulate a shared secret using Post-Quantum Hybrid KEM (X25519 + ML-KEM, RFC 9180/10024). Returns the classical ephemeral public key, ML-KEM ciphertext, and a symmetric-256 keyHandle for the combined shared secret. Secret key material stays inside the server; only an opaque keyHandle is returned.

x25519PublicKey.description: Hex-encoded recipient X25519 public key (64 hex characters).

mlKemPublicKey.description: Hex-encoded recipient ML-KEM public key (1600, 2368, or 3136 hex characters).

level.description: ML-KEM security level (512, 768, or 1024). Default is 768.

tools.title: Hybrid post-quantum KEM encapsulate

tools.name: crypto_hybrid_kem_decapsulate
tools.description: Recover a Post-Quantum Hybrid KEM shared secret (X25519 + ML-KEM) using server-held x25519 and ml-kem key handles. Returns a symmetric-256 keyHandle for the combined shared secret. Secret key material stays inside the server; only an opaque keyHandle is returned.

x25519KeyHandle.description: Handle of the recipient X25519 key. Key handles look like 'kh_' followed by 32 hex characters.

mlKemKeyHandle.description: Handle of the recipient ML-KEM key. Key handles look like 'kh_' followed by 32 hex characters.

x25519EphemeralPublic.description: Hex-encoded sender ephemeral X25519 public key (64 hex characters).

mlKemCiphertext.description: Hex-encoded ML-KEM ciphertext (1536, 2176, or 3136 hex characters).

level.description: ML-KEM security level (512, 768, or 1024). Default is inferred from key or 768.

tools.title: Hybrid post-quantum KEM decapsulate

tools.name: crypto_stream_encrypt
tools.description: Encrypt plaintext using post-quantum hybrid STREAM AEAD (X25519 + ML-KEM-768 + XChaCha20-Poly1305) with anti-truncation protection. Returns base64 ciphertext.

x25519PublicKey.description: Hex-encoded X25519 public key (64 hex characters).

mlKemPublicKey.description: Hex-encoded ML-KEM-768 public key (2368 hex characters).

tools.title: Stream encrypt data (post-quantum)

tools.name: crypto_stream_decrypt
tools.description: Decrypt a post-quantum hybrid STREAM AEAD ciphertext using server-held x25519 and ml-kem-768 key handles. Plaintext memory is wiped after decoding.

x25519KeyHandle.description: Handle of the recipient X25519 key (or 32-byte symmetric-256 key). Key handles look like 'kh_' followed by 32 hex characters.

mlKemKeyHandle.description: Handle of the recipient ML-KEM-768 key. Key handles look like 'kh_' followed by 32 hex characters.

tools.title: Stream decrypt data (post-quantum)

tools.name: crypto_stream_multi_encrypt
tools.description: Encrypt plaintext for multiple recipients using post-quantum hybrid STREAM AEAD (X25519 + ML-KEM-768 + XChaCha20-Poly1305) with anti-truncation framing. Returns base64 ciphertext.

recipients.description: JSON-serialized array of recipient public key descriptors: [{ recipientId, recipientX25519Public, recipientMlKemPublic }].

chunkSize.description: Chunk size in bytes (minimum 1024, maximum 16777216, default 65536).

tools.title: Multi-recipient stream encrypt data (post-quantum)

tools.name: crypto_stream_multi_decrypt
tools.description: Decrypt a multi-recipient post-quantum hybrid STREAM AEAD ciphertext using server-held x25519 and ml-kem-768 key handles. Plaintext memory is wiped after decoding.

x25519KeyHandle.description: Handle of the recipient X25519 key (or 32-byte symmetric-256 key). Key handles look like 'kh_' followed by 32 hex characters.

mlKemKeyHandle.description: Handle of the recipient ML-KEM-768 key. Key handles look like 'kh_' followed by 32 hex characters.

recipientId.description: Optional recipient identifier for direct slot lookup.

chunkSize.description: Chunk size in bytes (minimum 1024, maximum 16777216, default 65536).

tools.title: Multi-recipient stream decrypt data (post-quantum)

tools.name: crypto_hybrid_kem_multi_encapsulate
tools.description: Encapsulate a symmetric key for multiple recipients using post-quantum hybrid KEM (X25519 + ML-KEM-768 + AES-256-GCM key wrapping). Returns recipient ciphertexts and a symmetric-256 keyHandle.

recipients.description: JSON-serialized array of recipient public key objects: [{ id?, x25519PublicKey, mlKemPublicKey }].

keyHandle.description: Optional handle of an existing symmetric-256 key to encapsulate. If omitted, a fresh 256-bit DEK is generated. Key handles look like 'kh_' followed by 32 hex characters.

tools.title: Multi-recipient hybrid KEM encapsulate

tools.name: crypto_hybrid_kem_multi_decapsulate
tools.description: Decapsulate a multi-recipient post-quantum hybrid KEM key using server-held x25519 and ml-kem-768 key handles. Returns a symmetric-256 keyHandle for the recovered DEK.

x25519KeyHandle.description: Handle of recipient X25519 key. Key handles look like 'kh_' followed by 32 hex characters.

mlKemKeyHandle.description: Handle of recipient ML-KEM-768 key. Key handles look like 'kh_' followed by 32 hex characters.

ephemeralPublicKey.description: Hex-encoded sender ephemeral X25519 public key (64 hex characters).

wrappedKey.description: Base64-encoded wrapped DEK (RFC 3394 AES Key Wrap).

recipients.description: Optional JSON-serialized array of encrypted recipient objects: [{ id?, ephemeralPublicKey, mlKemCiphertext, encryptedKey }].

recipientId.description: Optional recipient ID to select from recipients array.

recipientIndex.description: Optional index to select from recipients array (default 0).

tools.title: Multi-recipient hybrid KEM decapsulate

tools.name: crypto_sign
tools.description: Sign data with a key handle. The algorithm follows the key: Ed25519, RSASSA-PSS (SHA-256), ECDSA (SHA-256; SHA-384 on P-384), ML-DSA (44, 65, 87, FIPS 204), or HMAC-SHA256.

keyHandle.description: Handle of an ed25519, rsa, ecc, ml-dsa, or hmac-sha256 key. Key handles look like 'kh_' followed by 32 hex characters.

tools.title: Sign data

tools.name: crypto_verify
tools.description: Verify a signature against a public key (SPKI PEM or ML-DSA hex) or a key handle (also HMAC-SHA256). Pass exactly one of publicKey or keyHandle.

publicKey.description: Public key in SPKI PEM format or ML-DSA hex format. Private keys are refused.

keyHandle.description: Handle of an ed25519, rsa, ecc, ml-dsa, or hmac-sha256 key. Key handles look like 'kh_' followed by 32 hex characters.

tools.title: Verify a signature

tools.name: crypto_hash
tools.description: Compute cryptographic digest (SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA3-256, BLAKE2b512).
tools.title: Hash data

tools.name: crypto_kms_wrap
tools.description: Wrap the Data Encryption Key (DEK) a symmetric-256 key handle refers to under a Key Encryption Key held by a KMS provider. Only the 'local' provider is configured.

provider.description: KMS provider ('aws', 'gcp', 'azure', 'vault', or 'local'). Only 'local' (random, in-process key material that does not survive a restart) is configured; the others return an error.

keyId.description: Label of the Key Encryption Key (KEK). It names the key; it is never used to derive it.

keyHandle.description: Handle of the symmetric-256 DEK to wrap. Key handles look like 'kh_' followed by 32 hex characters.

tools.title: Wrap a key (KMS)

tools.name: crypto_kms_unwrap
tools.description: Unwrap a DEK previously wrapped by crypto_kms_wrap in this server process into a symmetric-256 key handle. Only the 'local' provider is configured. Secret key material stays inside the server; only an opaque keyHandle is returned.

provider.description: KMS provider ('aws', 'gcp', 'azure', 'vault', or 'local'). Only 'local' (random, in-process key material that does not survive a restart) is configured; the others return an error.

keyId.description: Label of the Key Encryption Key (KEK). It names the key; it is never used to derive it.

tools.title: Unwrap a key (KMS)

result.description: Post-Quantum Cryptography Migration Plan for payments

content.text:
Please design a 4-phase Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) migration plan for payments in accordance with NIST FIPS 203/204/205 standards and NSA CNSA 2.0 timelines:

1. Cryptographic Asset Discovery & CBOM Generation
2. Hybrid Key Exchange (X25519MLKEM768 in TLS 1.3 per RFC 10024; hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-768 for data at rest)
3. Hardware & Memory Zeroization Audit (Wasm linear memory vs V8 GC heap)
4. Complete Deprecation of Classical Public Key Infrastructure.
